blurb: Midwest Helicopter Airways specializes in heavy lifting in the construction industry using Sikorsky S-58T and S-61 helicopters. They provide precision load setting for pipelines, HVAC, concrete pouring, communication towers, and crew/equipment transport. They operate in various locations including downtown high-rises, suburban schools, malls, and warehouses, following FAA rules and regulations.
